title: Arvell Reese plans to do edge rusher and linebacker drills at Combine

sources.title: Arvell Reese plans to do edge rusher and linebacker drills at Combine
sources.description: Arvell Reese is expected to be one of the top picks in this year's draft and one of the reasons he is so highly rated is the versatility he showed while playing for Ohio State.
